verdict.rationale: Customer.io docs confirm a Segments feature with examples like "Paying Customers" and "Have not logged in recently." Profiles 'join Segments' when they meet attribute conditions, and that joining can trigger automations, which implies dynamic membership that updates as data changes. An AI 'Describe segment' builder is also available. Behavioral-event conditions are only implied by an example segment name, tags are never mentioned, and no doc explicitly describes how segment membership stays live. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of event-based segment conditions, tag-based segmentation, explicit confirmation that segments recalculate in real time, and independent or hands-on corroboration of segmentation.
